title: It does many useful things..but..
body:
..the UI experience is dated. Moving tasks from list to list is slower than it could be (drag and drop, anyone?), why does the front page not show you your tasks but a classification view, from which you need to start digging your way to your tasks? The normal day to day "what next, what next" should be as fast as possible. Integration of tasks-to-calendar is not intuitive...is there one?

It has lists, marking stuff to done is easy, it has dates for items..hence I will give it 3.5..which will round to 4. But many easy improvements to UX available for designers.

Perhaps I need to read a manual.
